title: Skeleton and plant labelling diagrams
subject: Science
unit: Spring 2: Skeletons, muscles, nutrition and plants (Tribal Tales)
source: Seeded from science/y3 lesson 24 (Skeleton and plant labelling diagrams (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 24: End-of-unit check: skeletons, food and plants. To understand how well I can explain what I have learnt about skeletons, food and plants

picture.draw: Draw and label: Skeleton and plant labelling diagrams

questions.q: Label the skull, ribs, spine and a joint on the skeleton.
questions.a: Correct labels on the four parts
questions.model: Start with the easiest: the skull at the top protects the brain. Then the ribs round the chest.

questions.q: Name one vertebrate and one invertebrate.
End-of-unit quiz on the portal sheet: 10 questions on skeletons, muscles, food and plants (12 minutes).
questions.a: Answer key on the teacher sheet: 1 support, protect, move; 2 ribs; 3 contracts; 4 protein; 5 animals cannot make food; 6 root; 7 leaf; 8 light, water, warmth; 9 stem; 10 change one thing
questions.model: Teacher reads question 1 aloud and shows how to answer in full: 'The skeleton supports, protects and helps us move.'

questions.q: Write three sentences about the cress test: what we changed, what happened, what it showed.
questions.a: For example: We changed light, water and warmth. Pot 3 did not grow. Plants need water.

questions.q: Draw a food chain that starts with a plant and ends with you.
questions.a: For example: wheat → bread → me, or grass → cow → milk → me

questions.q: Big question: what is the most surprising thing you learnt?
